title: AnnData: dense H5AD to CSR/CSC
result: The replay supplies six paired samples for each of six cases. A separate independent audit reports approximately 2.19×.
mechanism: HDF5-aware traversal, direct sparse construction and native implementation reduce allocation and conversion overhead.
limitation: Warm page cache, one EPYC 7B12 core; conversion from open HDF5, not full public read_h5ad or remote I/O. Replay is not proof of historical retention compliance.
